fixtures.preview: New head coach Mauricio Pochettino faces the biggest rivalry in English football with only a few days' training behind him and United in the relegation zone.
talking_points: Pochettino replaced the sacked Michael Carrick on 13 Nov, so Anfield is his first match in charge.
United were 18th on 8 points from 10 and Liverpool 4th on 18 in Sky's 8 Nov table, which may have moved.
Marcus Rashford is hoped to be available after new treatment, but Luke Shaw is only targeting a return and hasn't been cleared (Sports Mole, 12 Nov).
Left-back Patrick Dorgu is a doubt with a hamstring problem, while Lisandro Martinez is available again after suspension.

fixtures.preview: Matchday 5 in Lisbon, with United 17th on 6 points and Sporting 10th on 9 after four games.
Brentford were 8th on 14 points in the 8 Nov table and visit Old Trafford, likely Pochettino's home debut.
A Wednesday-night trip to Tyneside against a side that was 12th on 12 points in the 8 Nov table; Sky says fixtures are subject to change.
Coventry were one place above United in 17th on 9 points in the 8 Nov table, so this is a relegation-zone six-pointer.
Matchweek 5 in Brisbane (6:40pm Brisbane time), with Sydney off a 4-1 win over Central Coast on 6 Nov.
talking_points: Al Hassan Toure scored his second hat-trick for the club in that 4-1 win and Gabriel Popovic scored his first Sydney goal.
Abel Walatee (ankle) and Jake Hollman (hamstring) are unavailable, per the club's squad article.
Ethan Dyer and Akol Akon are away at the FIFA U-17 World Cup, while Nicko Alfaro, Marin France and Tyler Williams were added to the extended squad.
Head coach Patrick Kisnorbo said after the Mariners win that 'the best is yet to come'.

fixtures.preview: The Big Blue at Allianz Stadium on Sunday 6 December at 5pm.
A Grand Final rematch in Auckland at 5pm New Zealand time (3pm Sydney).
A Friday-night home game against Perth Glory at 7:40pm.
A Monday-night home game against Macarthur FC at 7pm.

big_matches.title: Newcastle United v Arsenal
big_matches.why: Table-topping Arsenal travel to St James' Park.
talking_points: Arsenal led the table on 27 points from 10 games in Sky's 8 Nov table, five clear of Brighton.

big_matches.title: Liverpool v Manchester United
big_matches.why: English football's biggest rivalry, with United in the relegation zone under new coach Mauricio Pochettino.

United were 18th on 8 points and Liverpool 4th on 18 in the 8 Nov table.
Rashford is hoped to be fit and Shaw is not yet cleared; Dorgu is a doubt.

notes: Many sources blocked automated access or gave thin results this run (BBC, Rebel, Coles, Woolworths, Aldi, UEFA match lists, the A-Leagues match list), so some items rely on earlier checks and are flagged.

Man Utd: Liverpool line-ups aren't confirmed; injury notes are from Sports Mole on 12–13 Nov. Table positions are from Sky's 8 Nov table and may have moved. Premier League and Champions League broadcasts are listed as Stan Sport (UEFA's partner list and Stan coverage).

Sydney FC: the club's pages list nothing between 21 Nov and 6 Dec, so a matchweek 6 game may be missing. A single preview site listed a derby on 29 Nov, but the A-Leagues guide puts the next derbies on 30 Jan and 3 Apr, so it was left out.

Big matches: ATP Finals (Turin, to 22 Nov) is on beIN Sports, but the final's time wasn't confirmed so it isn't listed. Basketball and tennis in Sydney: no home Sydney Kings games or tennis events were found in the next 4 weeks.

Local: school dates come from the Term 4 calendars and the Week 6 Principal Updates and may change. Nothing was found for the second school. The Redfern Oval upgrade and other Redfern News headlines couldn't be dated, so they're not listed.
Groceries: only items confirmed in OzBargain's 18–24 Nov catalogue roundup are listed. It had no fresh fruit, veg or eggs and no Aldi prices, and no matcha special was found.
Deals: Rebel's Black Friday page was blocked, so no football-boot discounts are listed. Several deals link to OzBargain posts; check the retailer before buying.

Son and daughter sections are thin: no junior parkrun, Pokémon or Roblox event, and no kids' author talk or book fair in Sydney in the next four weeks, was confirmed. Sydney FC's holiday clinic dates aren't published on the club's page.
